concept.title: Targeting requirements
concept.shortdesc: Set an artifact's releases in its editor, under Releases:

ul.li: From a release: the artifact is introduced in that release and stays in every later one.
With a last release as well, it is in the releases from the first to the last, inclusive. Choose only to plan it for one release alone, or a later release for a capability that is retired after it.
Leave the first release unset and the artifact takes its parent's releases. Set the releases on a heading, and every requirement under it is planned for them, unless a requirement sets its own.

conbody.p: The editor says where an inherited range comes from. A project with no releases shows no Releases field.
Agents set the same thing with the set_release_target tool, and read progress with get_release_progress.
